app_updated.description: The app version changed since the previous launch

previous_version.description: App version before the update, e.g. 1.2.0

app_opened.description: The app came to the foreground

cold_start.description: True if the process was started, false if resumed from the background

session_started.description: A new session began (first open, or after 30 minutes in the background)

session_ended.description: A session ended after 30 minutes in the background; recorded when the next one starts

duration_seconds.description: Time in the foreground during the session

screen.description: Screen name chosen by the app, e.g. paywall or lesson_list

experiment_exposed.description: A parameter decided by an experiment was read for the first time in the session

experiment.description: Experiment key from the config, e.g. paywall_test

variant.description: Variant the user is assigned to, e.g. control

config_version.description: Config version the assignment came from
